# DeviceAI browser client

This is the bundled `@deviceai/client` 0.1.0 ESM build from [Yz613/deviceai](https://github.com/Yz613/deviceai), revision `f73b250`. It is vendored so Unified Inbox builds without access to the private DeviceAI repository. To update it, build the client in that repository and copy its `dist/index.js` and `index.d.ts` here, then update the version and revision in this file.
